correctness.rationale: Detailed eta-quotient mod18 sums and all six cusp orders prove F is in S5(Gamma0(18),chi_-3) with integer q-coefficients and first coefficient -80=1 mod3. The Deligne--Serre theorem with (l,k,N)=(3,5,18), n=r=1 gives infinitely many p=1 mod54 with a(p)=2 mod3. Exact 36H dissection gives T(8p)=72 mod108; published initial-vector and internal scalar congruences transfer nonzero normalized residue to every m. Finite recurrence checker supplements, not substitutes for, these infinite steps.
